about.description: HaBuk is a complete restaurant technology ecosystem developed in North Macedonia. We build the software that connects every layer of your operation, from the moment a guest opens the app to the moment the order lands on the table.
about.missionText: Restaurants deserve software that works as hard as they do. We build tools that are fast, reliable, and actually used by staff, managers, and customers alike.
about.locationText: Based in North Macedonia, serving restaurants across the region. Our team builds, maintains, and supports every product in the ecosystem.
